sources.notes: The review needs to connect model-level heterogeneous pretraining with capture-device, viewpoint, temporal, codec, and embodiment-interface constraints.

queries.label: dynamic-heterogeneous-vla-pretraining
queries.query: (all:"vision-language-action" OR all:"robot foundation model") AND (all:heterogeneous OR all:"data mixture" OR all:"multi-embodiment")
queries.why: Find recent VLA work that explicitly studies heterogeneous source mixtures and cross-embodiment pretraining.

queries.label: dynamic-capture-parameters
queries.query: (all:"robot learning" OR all:"robot dataset") AND (all:"camera resolution" OR all:"frame rate" OR all:"field of view")
queries.why: Recover dataset and system papers that disclose capture resolution, temporal rate, FOV, and camera placement.

queries.label: dynamic-viewpoint-camera-domain
queries.query: (all:"robot pretraining" OR all:"vision-language-action") AND (all:viewpoint OR all:"camera domain" OR all:egocentric OR all:wrist-camera)
queries.why: Test whether viewpoint and camera-domain diversity are learned as invariances or require explicit alignment.

queries.label: dynamic-negative-transfer-diversity
queries.query: (all:"robot manipulation" OR all:"vision-language-action") AND (all:"negative transfer" OR all:"expert diversity" OR all:"embodiment gap" OR all:"action mismatch")
queries.why: Find counterevidence to the intuition that every additional source or collection setup improves pretraining.

browser_fallback_queries.label: dynamic-specs-browser
browser_fallback_queries.query: site:arxiv.org/abs robot dataset camera resolution fps FOV wrist camera VLA 2025 2026
browser_fallback_queries.why: Search full paper records for capture specifications that may be absent from metadata.

web_calibration_queries.label: dynamic-current-data-mixtures-web
web_calibration_queries.query: site:arxiv.org/abs 2026 VLA heterogeneous data sources egocentric robot simulation pretraining
web_calibration_queries.why: Calibrate current terminology for mixed-source VLA pretraining.
